name: STICKEE | Peach Ringz | 1G | Live Resin Disposable
description: Meet Peach Ringz: Sweet on the Lips, Chill on the Body. Peach Ringz is like raiding the gas station candy aisle, except instead of sugar and cavities, you get clouds of peach-soaked happiness. Juicy, tangy, and just the right amount of sweet, every puff hits like your favorite gummy snack got a glow-up. On the inhale you’ll taste ripe peach candy magic, on the exhale a smooth live resin finish that keeps it bold, balanced, and ridiculously tasty. This isn’t just nostalgia, it’s nostalgia with horsepower. The high is uplifting, buzzy, and social up top, then eases into a mellow body glow that feels like slipping into your comfiest hoodie. Peach Ringz is the cart that takes you back to childhood candy runs, but makes sure adult-you gets the better deal: big flavor and full spectrum.
